entities.summary: Alfred Fedetsky was a prominent photographer and filmmaker in the Russian Empire. He was of Polish descent. He authored numerous portraits of notable Russian people as well as members of the Imperial family. He was the personal photographer of Duchess Alexandra Petrovna of Oldenburg.
